title: LinkedIn writing architecture — source registry
scope: Reusable writing patterns and composition architecture; no publication, outreach, collector recovery or new creator-post acquisition.
verification_scope: Verified_on records this review and its stated access level. It does not assert full-text inspection where access was partial, independent replication or current operational access.

type_key.P: Policy or rule; scope-bound normative documentation.
type_key.D: Platform self-description, including documented system behavior, features and metric definitions.
type_key.G: Editorial guidance; not automatically a causal finding.
type_key.M: Promotional quantitative claim; methodology and independence must be assessed.
type_key.E: Original editorial synthesis; a proposed method, not an empirically validated distribution formula.
type_key.T: Primary scholarly research or theoretical account; context and access limits retained.
type_key.B: Provider first-party description of its own service or case.
type_key.C: Preserved derived corpus interpretation, not a newly inspected original post.
type_key.L: Local project record or deterministic descriptive measurement.
